About the role
We are looking for a Data Center Engineer to support the installation, operation and maintenance of data center infrastructure. You will help ensure that servers, storage, networks and supporting facilities operate securely and reliably.
You will work closely with infrastructure teams, facilities specialists and external vendors to resolve incidents, deliver changes and maintain service availability.
Key responsibilities
Install, configure and maintain servers, storage systems and network equipment.


Perform rack-and-stack activities, hardware replacements and structured cabling.


Monitor infrastructure health, investigate faults and coordinate incident resolution.


Support operating system maintenance, patching and hardware lifecycle management.


Carry out approved changes using documented procedures, validation checks and rollback plans.


Support backup, recovery and disaster recovery activities.


Maintain asset inventories, rack layouts, cabling records and operational documentation.


Coordinate with facilities teams on power, cooling, environmental monitoring and physical security.


Work with vendors on maintenance, equipment deliveries and hardware support.


Follow access controls, safety procedures and change management processes.


Participate in scheduled maintenance and on-call support where required.



Required qualifications
Relevant experience in data center operations, infrastructure support or a similar technical role.


Hands-on knowledge of server hardware, storage and networking fundamentals.


Experience with Linux and/or Windows Server environments.


Understanding of virtualization technologies such as VMware, Hyper-V or KVM.


Familiarity with fiber and copper cabling, rack infrastructure and hardware diagnostics.


Understanding of incident management, change management and operational documentation.


Strong troubleshooting, communication and organizational skills.


Ability to work independently and collaborate with technical teams and vendors.


Professional working proficiency in English.



Preferred qualifications
Experience with SAN/NAS storage, backup platforms or disaster recovery testing.


Familiarity with infrastructure monitoring and Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM) tools.


Scripting or automation experience using PowerShell, Bash, Python or Ansible.


Exposure to cloud connectivity and hybrid infrastructure.


Relevant certifications in networking, servers, virtualization or IT service management.

job_description:
Bannerflow is a fast-growing global SaaS company building a Creative Intelligence Platform that enables enterprise brands to predict, create, and optimize advertising across channels.
We’re on a company-wide AI transformation journey, where AI and agentic workflows are becoming a core part of how we build and innovate, with high expectations on adoption across all teams.
Our teams are highly autonomous, collaborative, and we are now looking for another passionate engineer to join us!
The challenge: Scaling data for the future
Our platform serves 500+ million impressions daily, with peaks over 1 billion impressions, and we’re just getting started. We’re currently rebuilding our entire data infrastructure from the ground up to adopt a data lakehouse approach, enabling:

Scalability & Flexibility: Handling billions of data points while staying cost-efficient and future-proof.


Data-Driven Features (AI & ML): Enabling predictive models and automation based on historical data.


Business Intelligence & Analytics: Delivering insights directly to customers in our platform.


To make this vision a reality, we’re looking for an experienced Data Platform Engineer to join our Platform team, and take full ownership of designing and building a scalable, high-performance data platform that will power the next generation of our product.
Are you + Bannerflow = True? 🦋
We believe this is an opportunity for you who want to take the technical lead and define our data platform and best practices. Your work will directly impact customers and drive innovation in Ad Tech as part of an autonomous tech team. You'll tackle cutting-edge challenges in large-scale data processing, ML pipelines, and advanced analytics.
At Bannerflow, we live by our values of passion, collaboration, and challenge. You'll be part of a vibrant culture with activities like padel tournaments, webinars, Friday beers, and Level-up Hackathons. We offer a hybrid workplace and a competitive compensation package, including pension according to ITP1, health allowance, parental leave top-up, and health care insurance.
Your mission
Design and build scalable data pipelines for analytics and AI-driven features.


Build on our existing lakehouse foundations to shape the architecture's next stage, balancing performance, flexibility, and cost.


Ensure high data quality and reliability, implementing best practices in data modelling, governance and observability.


Collaborate closely with our Data Analysts, Chief Architect, Engineers, and Product teams to create data-driven features and insights.


Evaluate and implement new technologies to ensure a modern, scalable, and future-proof data stack.

So, what are we looking for?
5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer/Data Platform Engineer/Data Lead, working with large-scale data processing.


Strong knowledge of cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Azure, or AWS).


Experience working with data lake and lakehouse technologies (cloud storage solutions, Iceberg tables, Delta Lake, etc.).


Experience with designing scalable architectures and pipelines that support large datasets efficiently.


Passion for AI/ML-driven data features and enabling advanced analytics.


Problem-solver mindset, you love optimizing performance and building robust systems.


Curiosity & ownership – you thrive in an environment where you can experiment and improve.

Not sure if you check all the boxes? Apply anyway!
We believe that mindset and passion are just as important as technical skills. If you have a software engineering background, love solving complex problems, and are a data nerd at heart, we’d love to hear from you, even if you don’t meet every requirement. We’re looking for the right person, not just the perfect resume. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities.
Join us at Bannerflow and help us build a world-class data platform that powers the future of Ad Tech!

job_description:
Solve complex problems. Decode the future.
At Electrolux Group, as a leading global appliance company, we strive every day to shape living for the better for our consumers, our people and our planet. We share ideas and collaborate so that together, we can develop solutions that deliver enjoyable and sustainable living. 
Come join us as you are. We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and more innovative. In our global community of people from 100+ countries, we listen to each other, actively contribute, and grow together. 
Join us in our exciting quest to build the future home.
 
All about the role:
As a Platform Data Engineer, you are an architect and builder of the foundations. You do not just move data; you build the resilient infrastructure, automated tooling, and scalable systems that allow the entire analytics ecosystem to function. 
Your mission is to eliminate human bottlenecks by stitching together complex components into a high-performance, controlled, and reliable data engine. You will match the capabilities and scale of the platform to our unique business requirements, ensuring that every byte of data is stored, orchestrated, and accessed with maximum efficiency and minimum manual intervention.
 
 
What you'll do:
 
●     Infrastructure & Platform Engineering: Design, build, and maintain the physical and logical architecture of our data platform. You ensure the platform evolves with our needs, moving beyond a "set it and forget it" mentality to a dynamic, scalable system.
●     Ingestion & Integration: Build the ingestion layer to take raw data from various internal and external sources and integrate it seamlessly into the analytical platform for processing.
●     Automation & Developer Experience: Champion the "machine-first" approach by automating repetitive tasks and building software to handle data efficiently. You ensure that data foundations are built on code, not manual inputs or human-heavy workflows.
●     Orchestration & Workflow Management: Turn computational chaos into a controlled ecosystem by designing complex orchestration chains that distribute, monitor, and recover processes automatically.
●     System Reliability & Performance: Optimize SQL queries, schema designs, and distributed processing tasks to ensure the platform remains performant as scale increases.
●     Security & Cost Control: Implement tightly designed access controls and resource management strategies to ensure compliance and prevent cloud bills from skyrocketing.
 
Qualifications:
●     Technical Background: Proven track record as a builder in cloud-based data environments (preferably Azure) with a focus on System Design and Architecture.
●     Software Engineering Mindset: Strong foundation in Python development and experience with distributed data processing (e.g., Spark).
●     Expertise in Data Structures: Deep knowledge of Data Warehouses, Lakes, and Lakehouses, including query optimization and schema design.
●     Automation: Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automated testing to ensure platform resilience and maintainability.
●     Problem Solving: The ability to take a complex chain of computations and turn it into a controlled, reliable ecosystem that recovers easily from failure.
 
Valuable extras:
●     Experience in MLOps Engineering to support model development and deployment.
●     Knowledge of Security & Governance frameworks (encryption, access control, and compliance).
●     Familiarity with Observability & Monitoring tools (logging, metrics, and audit trails) to ensure platform health.
 
 
Where you'll be:
This is a position based at our Global Headquarters in Stockholm (Sweden).
We are proud of our culture of inclusivity and diversity. At our Global Headquarters we have 60+ nationalities working together for our common goals. You will be part of this dynamic international team where English is the natural language.
 
We look forward to receiving your application!
 As part of Electrolux, we will continuously invest in you and your development. There are no barriers to where your career could take you.

job_description:
We're looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer to take ownership of the platform that powers our data products, from real-time APIs our customers depend on to the batch pipelines behind our analytics. You'll work across a lambda architecture that combines a low-latency streaming layer built in Go with a batch layer on Google Cloud, running on infrastructure spread across AWS, Azure, and GCP in regions around the world.
This is a hands-on senior role with real technical leadership. Beyond building and maintaining the platform, you'll set the bar for engineering quality on the team, shape how we design services so they stay modular and scalable as we grow, and act as tech lead and mentor for junior engineers.
Build and evolve the data platform
Develop and maintain our real-time layer, including the Go-based gateway and processing engine that serve customer-facing workloads with high availability and low latency.
Own and improve the batch layer on GCP, working with BigQuery, Airflow, and dbt to deliver reliable, well-modelled, and cost-efficient pipelines.
Keep the speed and batch layers consistent with each other, making sure data is correct, reconcilable, and trustworthy regardless of which path it takes.

Design and ship customer-facing backend services
Design, build, and operate backend APIs that customers use directly, with strong attention to contracts, versioning, performance, and backwards compatibility.
Think through failure modes, observability, and scaling up front, so services behave predictably in production.

Own multi-cloud infrastructure
Manage and evolve our infrastructure across AWS, Azure, and GCP in multiple global regions using Terraform.
Improve how we structure infrastructure code through reusable modules, sensible environment separation, and safe, repeatable deployments.
Drive improvements in monitoring, alerting, security, and cost visibility across clouds. Participate in a shared on-call rotation for production systems.

Raise the bar on engineering excellence
Define and champion engineering standards around code quality, testing, code review, CI/CD, and documentation.
Lead technical design discussions and write clear design documents for significant changes, bringing the team along in the reasoning.
Identify technical debt and architectural weak points and build a pragmatic plan to address them alongside feature work.

Lead and mentor
Serve as tech lead for the team, guiding technical direction and helping prioritize work (this role has no direct reports).
Mentor two junior engineers through pairing, thoughtful code reviews, and gradually increasing ownership, helping them grow into confident, independent engineers.

REQUIREMENTS 
Significant professional experience as a software or data engineer (typically 6+ years), including time spent owning production systems end to end.
Strong software engineering fundamentals: clean and modular design, testing strategies, API design, and an understanding of distributed systems trade-offs.
Experience building and operating backend services in a compiled or typed language such as Go, Java, Kotlin, Rust, or similar.
Hands-on experience with a modern data stack, ideally BigQuery, Airflow, and dbt or close equivalents.
Solid experience with infrastructure as code using Terraform, and working knowledge of at least one major cloud provider in depth.
Familiarity with both real-time/streaming and batch data processing patterns, and the challenges of combining them.
A track record of mentoring others and raising the quality of the teams you've been part of.
Clear written and verbal communication, especially the ability to explain technical decisions and trade-offs to engineers of varying experience.

Nice to have
Professional experience with Go. This is a strong plus, though we'll happily support an experienced backend engineer in going deep on it.
Experience running infrastructure across multiple clouds and regions, including networking, identity, and data residency considerations.
Background with lambda or kappa architectures, event streaming systems (such as Kafka or Pub/Sub), or high-throughput API gateways.
Experience with observability tooling (metrics, tracing, logging) and cloud cost optimization.

Our corporate language is English, please submit your application in English.
This is a hybrid role based in Stockholm, Sweden, and reporting to the Senior Engineering Manager. 
Candidates must have the right to work in Sweden. Relocation and work permit sponsorship are not available for this role.
OUR HIRING PROCESS 
We are committed to ensuring a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and inclusive. Our approach includes structured, competency-based interviews designed to evaluate your skills, experience, and qualifications relevant to the role. At times, we may include a data-driven assessment to enhance our hiring success and identify candidates likely to excel. 
We believe in a two-way process and encourage you to ask questions throughout the journey. If this role isn't what you're looking for, please explore the other opportunities listed on our career page: https://www.sinch.com/careers/. No matter who you are, we hope you find an exciting path forward - hopefully with us!

Om Conapto
Conapto är en svensk datacenter-operatör med fyra datacenter och huvudkontor i Stockholm. Vi erbjuder säker och hållbar colocation för företag med höga krav på prestanda och tillgänglighet, och skapar lösningar som möter behoven hos allt från avancerade IT-miljöer till high performance computing och den snabbt växande utvecklingen inom artificiell intelligens (AI).
Conapto verkar i en snabbväxande bransch och befinner sig i en expansiv fas med fortsatt utveckling av vår kapacitet i Stockholmsregionen. Som operatörsneutral aktör erbjuder vi våra kunder flexibla och framtidssäkra lösningar för deras digitala infrastruktur.
Hållbarhet är en integrerad del av vår verksamhet. Våra datacenter drivs med 100 % förnybar el och överskottsvärme återvinns till lokala fjärrvärmenät i samarbete med Stockholm Exergi och Sollentuna Energi & Miljö. Vi bidrar även till stabiliteten i det svenska elnätet genom balanstjänster.
Kundupplevelsen står i centrum och Conapto har idag ett Net Promoter Score (NPS) på +85, vilket speglar det starka förtroende som kunderna har för Conapto.
Sedan 2021 ägs Conapto av den europeiska infrastrukturfonden Marguerite. Conapto bildades 2018 genom förvärvet av Sungard Availability Services svenska verksamhet, med en historia inom datacenterbranschen som sträcker sig tillbaka till 1982.
Vi söker nu en Data Center Engineer inom Operations
Vill du arbeta med kritisk infrastruktur i en modern och växande verksamhet?
Conapto söker nu en Data Center Engineer inom Operations till vårt norra datacenter campus i Sollentuna. Här får du en central roll i den dagliga driften och utvecklingen av vår datacenterverksamhet, med stort eget ansvar och möjlighet att påverka.
Om rollen
Som Data Center Engineer blir du en viktig del av Operations teamet och ansvarar för att säkerställa en stabil, säker och högkvalitativ drift av vår kritiska infrastruktur. Rollen är praktisk och teknisk, med en kombination av kundkontakt, installationer, felsökning och löpande underhåll.
Du arbetar nära både kunder och kollegor och behöver därför vara trygg i din tekniska kompetens, kommunikativ och lösningsorienterad. Du får ett stort eget ansvar och förväntas ta initiativ, identifiera förbättringsmöjligheter och bidra till att utveckla våra arbetssätt.
Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter kommer bland annat att vara:
Planera och genomföra kundinstallationer i datacentret
Ansvar för installation och inmätning av fiber/kommunikationsinfrastruktur
Utföra felsökning och incidenthantering i dialog med kunder
Genomföra regelbundna inspektioner och ronder
Installera och konfigurera hårdvara i datahallsmiljö
Underhåll av kritisk infrastruktur

english_description:
About Conapto
Conapto is a Swedish data center operator with four data centers and headquarters in Stockholm. We offer safe and sustainable colocation for companies with high demands on performance and availability, creating solutions that meet the needs of everything from advanced IT environments to high performance computing and the rapidly growing development of artificial intelligence (AI).
Conapto operates in a fast-growing industry and is in an expansive phase with continued development of our capacity in the Stockholm region. As an operator-neutral operator, we offer our customers flexible and future-proof solutions for their digital infrastructure.
Sustainability is an integral part of our business. Our data centers are powered by 100% renewable electricity and excess heat is recycled to local district heating networks in cooperation with Stockholm Exergi and Sollentuna Energy & Environment. We also contribute to the stability of the Swedish electricity grid through balance services.
Conapto currently has a Net Promoter Score (NPS) on +85, reflecting the strong confidence customers have for Conapto.
Since 2021 is owned Conapto of the European Marguerite infrastructure fund. Conapto was founded in 2018 through the acquisition of Sungard Availability Services’ Swedish operations, with a history in the data center industry dating back to 1982.
We are now looking for a Data Center Engineer in Operations.
Do you want to work with critical infrastructure in a modern and growing business?
Conapto is looking for a Data Center Engineer within Operations to our North Data Center campus in Sollentuna. Here you will gain a central role in the day-to-day operation and development of our data center operations, with great responsibility and ability to influence.
About the Role
as Data Center Engineer becomes an important part of the Operations team and is responsible for ensuring a stable, safe and high-quality operation of our critical infrastructure. The role is practical and technical, with a combination of customer contact, installations, troubleshooting and ongoing maintenance.
You work closely with both customers and colleagues and therefore need to be confident in your technical skills, communicative and solution-oriented. You get a great responsibility and are expected to take initiatives, identify improvement opportunities and help develop our working methods.
Your main tasks will include:
Planning and implementing customer installations in the data center
Responsibility for the installation and measurement of fibre/communication infrastructure
Conduct troubleshooting and incident management in dialogue with customers
Perform regular inspections and rounds
Install and configure hardware in data hall environment
Maintenance of critical infrastructure
Contribute to continuous improvements in operations, processes and working methods

About you:
We are looking for you who have good experience in operation and maintenance in a critical business and who enjoy working practically and technically. You are used to working structured and carefully, even in situations where there are high standards of quality and safety.
At least 8 years of experience in operation and maintenance in critical operations
Technical compensation in fiber and copper networks
Good experience in the installation of hardware in the data hall environment
Very good knowledge in Swedish and English in both speech and writing
B driving license

More about you:
As a person, we see that you are careful, structured and enjoy working in teams. You like to share new knowledge, challenge old truths and share your experience. You have a strong customer focus and delivering high quality service with first-class response is important to you.

Conapto is a challenger in the industry that grows fast and has very satisfied and interesting customers. You can contribute to a business that is in an exciting growth phase. job_description:
Vill du arbeta med AI, data och programvaruutveckling och omsätta ny teknik till lösningar som skapar verklig nytta? Vi söker en lösningsorienterad AI & Data Solution Engineer till Combitech i Göteborg. Hos oss får du möjlighet att utvecklas i en företagskultur som uppmuntrar både professionell och personlig utveckling, samtidigt som vi värdesätter anställningstrygghet och balans i livet. Som medarbetare på Combitech i Göteborg är du med och utvecklar framtidens digitala lösningar för industri och samhälle.


 Din roll som AI & Data Solution Engineer

Du blir en del av ett team som utvecklar intelligenta och datadrivna lösningar som hjälper våra kunder att automatisera, optimera och effektivisera sina verksamhets- och produktflöden. Vi arbetar med hela kedjan, från data och AI till utveckling, integration och driftsättning av kompletta lösningar i kundernas verksamheter. Som AI & Data Solution Engineer kombinerar du AI, data engineering och programvaruutveckling för att skapa lösningar som ger verkligt affärsvärde.
Arbetet kan omfatta områden som Machine Learning, generativ AI, AI-agenter, RAG-lösningar, datahantering, datapipelines men också systemintegration och backendutveckling. Du arbetar nära kunderna för att förstå verksamhetens behov och omsätta dessa till hållbara tekniska lösningar. En viktig del av rollen är att integrera AI- och datakapabiliteter med kundspecifik programvara och befintliga IT-system.
Eftersom vi arbetar med kunder i olika branscher och miljöer varierar både uppdrag och teknikval. Du kan exempelvis komma att arbeta med AI- och dataplattformar i Azure, AWS eller kundernas egna miljöer. Det kan innebära tekniker och plattformar som Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, Kubernetes, Airflow, Kafka, Spark, Iceberg eller DataHub. Vilka verktyg som används avgörs dock alltid av kundens behov, verksamhetskrav och säkerhetsförutsättningar.
Vi arbetar både i publika moln och i on-premises-miljöer, vilket ger möjlighet att utveckla lösningar för organisationer med höga krav på säkerhet, tillgänglighet och regelefterlevnad.
Våra kunder finns inom områden som försvar, samhällskritisk infrastruktur, offentlig sektor, processindustri och Industri 4.0. Det innebär att du får arbeta med avancerade tekniska utmaningar där data och AI används för att skapa konkreta verksamhetsnyttor.


 Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som är nyfiken, kreativ, lösningsorienterad och som drivs av att arbeta i teknikens framkant. Du har ett stort intresse för AI, data och programvaruutveckling och tycker om att omsätta tekniska möjligheter till lösningar som skapar konkret nytta. Vi värdesätter din tekniska nyfikenhet, din vilja att lära dig och din förmåga att tillsammans med andra lösa komplexa problem. Du trivs med att arbeta i team och samarbeta med både tekniska specialister och kunder. Du har också förmåga att förstå verksamhetens behov och att förklara komplexa tekniska koncept på ett begripligt sätt för personer med olika teknisk bakgrund. Vi tror att du har en civil- eller högskoleingenjörsexamen inom exempelvis AI, teknisk matematik, datateknik eller informationsteknik, alternativt annan relevant universitetsutbildning med inriktning mot AI, Data Science eller programvaruutveckling. Vi välkomnar både dig som har flera års erfarenhet och dig som är i början av din karriär. Det viktiga för oss är din tekniska nyfikenhet, din ambitionsnivå och din vilja att utvecklas tillsammans med oss och våra kunder.
Rollen förutsätter goda kunskaper i både engelska och svenska, i tal och skrift. 

Då tjänsten innebär arbete som omfattas av försvarssekretess krävs det att du genomför och godkänns i en säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll.

Urval sker löpande, Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!


 Kom & gör skillnad

Vi tror att man gör ett bättre jobb om man kan fokusera på rätt saker, därför gör vi det lätt att kombinera jobbet med vardagen. Vi satsar på våra medarbetare, de utgör kärnan, hjärnan och hjärtat i vår verksamhet. Dessutom står vi på en stadig grund av högteknologi, forskning och anställningstrygghet med försvars- och säkerhetskoncernen Saab som ägare.
För oss handlar det om hållbarhet - vi vill bli branschens mest hållbara företag; och för att vara ett hållbart företag i en hållbar framtid behöver vi investera i våra medarbetare. För oss är din återhämtning, dina utvecklingsmöjligheter och din trygghet lika viktigt som företagets framgång - utan våra medarbetare står vi stilla.
Vill du veta mer om hur det är att arbeta hos oss? Kolla in våra karriärsidor!
Kontaktperson/ rekryterande chef: Ingvar Andersson - ingvar.andersson(@)combitech.com
Vi undanber oss rekryteringssamarbeten. Inga ansökningar mottages via mail.
english_description:
Do you want to work with AI, data and software development and turn new technologies into solutions that create real benefits? We are looking for a solution-oriented AI & Data Solution Engineer for Combitech in Gothenburg. With us, you will have the opportunity to develop in a corporate culture that encourages both professional and personal development, while also valuing employment security and balance in life. As a co-worker at Combitech in Gothenburg, you are involved in developing the digital solutions of the future for industry and society.


Your role as AI & Data Solution Engineer

You become part of a team that develops intelligent and data-driven solutions that help our customers automate, optimize and streamline their business and product flows. We work with the entire chain, from data and AI to the development, integration and deployment of complete solutions in customers’ operations. As an AI & Data Solution Engineer, you combine AI, data engineering and software development to create solutions that deliver real business value.
The work may include areas such as Machine Learning, generative AI, AI agents, RAG solutions, data management, data pipelines but also system integration and backend development. You work closely with customers to understand the business needs and turn them into sustainable technical solutions. An important part of the role is to integrate AI and data capabilities with customer-specific software and existing IT systems.
Since we work with customers in different industries and environments, both missions and technology choices vary. For example, you can work with AI and data platforms in Azure, AWS or customers’ own environments. It may involve technologies and platforms such as Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, Kubernetes, Airflow, Kafka, Spark, Iceberg or DataHub. However, the tools used are always determined by the customer’s needs, operational requirements and safety conditions.
We work both in public clouds and on-premises environments, providing the opportunity to develop solutions for organizations with high demands on security, availability and compliance.
Our customers are located in areas such as defence, critical infrastructure, the public sector, the process industry and Industry 4.0. This means that you get to work with advanced technical challenges where data and AI are used to create tangible business benefits.


Who are you?

We are looking for you who are curious, creative, solution-oriented and driven by working at the forefront of technology. You have a great interest in AI, data and software development and enjoy turning technical opportunities into solutions that create concrete benefits. We value your technical curiosity, your willingness to learn and your ability to solve complex problems with others. You enjoy working in teams and collaborating with both technical specialists and customers. You also have the ability to understand the needs of the business and to explain complex technical concepts in a comprehensible way to people with different technical backgrounds. We believe that you have a civil or college engineering degree in, for example, AI, technical mathematics, computer engineering or information technology, or other relevant university education with a focus on AI, Data Science or software development. We welcome you who have years of experience and you who are at the beginning of your career. What matters to us is your technical curiosity, your level of ambition and your willingness to develop with us and our customers.
The role assumes good knowledge in both English and Swedish, in speech and writing.

When the service involves work covered by defence confidentiality, you must conduct and be approved in a security review with register control.

Selection is ongoing, we look forward to your application!


Come and make a difference

We believe that you do a better job if you can focus on the right things, so we make it easy to combine work with everyday life. We invest in our employees, they form the core, brain and heart of our business. In addition, we are on a steady basis of high technology, research and job security with the defence and security group Saab as owner.
For us, this is about sustainability – we want to be the industry’s most sustainable company; and to be a sustainable company in a sustainable future, we need to invest in our employees. For us, your recovery, your development opportunities and your security are as important as the success of the company – without our employees we stand still.
Want to know more about how it is to work with us? Check out our career pages!
Contact person / recruiting manager: Ingvar Andersson - invar.andersson(@)combitech.com
We avoid recruitment cooperation. No applications are received by mail.

job_description:
Autocom is a high-tech company that develops advanced diagnostic equipment for vehicles. Our end customers include vehicle repair shops and inspection companies. Our Autocom products are available in most European countries, and we work with several major companies worldwide in the automotive aftermarket. Our economic growth is stable, which allows us to continue to hire new employees, and we currently have around 120 employees. Autocom is part of the Würth Group, which has over 90,000 employees globally. More information about AUTOCOM can be found at www.autocom.se.

About the role
As a Data Solutions Engineer, you will work with complex vehicle data and build reliable data flows that turn fragmented information into structured, high-quality data for our diagnostic products. You will work across the entire data flow, from ingestion and transformation to validation and delivery, with a strong focus on data quality, automation and scalable solutions.
You will play an important role in developing and maintaining the data pipelines that form the foundation of our diagnostic products. This position combines hands-on development with problem-solving and continuous improvement and you will work independently on technical solutions while collaborating closely with software developers, data developers and other teams across the organization.
Your responsibilities will include:

Designing and developing scalable ETL/ELT pipelines.


Working with data ingestion, transformation, validation and delivery.


Ensuring data quality through automated testing and monitoring.


Identifying and resolving data errors, anomalies and pipeline issues.


Automating manual and repetitive data management processes.


Contributing to data modelling and cloud-based data solutions.


Translating technical requirements and vehicle protocols into reliable and useful datasets together with software developers, data developers and other stakeholders.


What you bring
We are looking for someone with solid experience in software development, data engineering or data solutions, who is comfortable taking ownership of technical solutions from idea to implementation. You enjoy working hands-on and solving technical problems, while also being able to step back, identify opportunities for improvement and contribute your own ideas on technical solutions and ways of working.
A relevant university degree is an advantage, but your professional experience will be the most important factor.
We believe you have:

Solid experience in programming and software development, for example Python.


Experience working with data management, data transformation and/or data pipelines.


Experience working with structured data such as XML, JSON and APIs.


The ability to independently drive technical solutions and take ownership of your work.


Good Swedish and English skills, both spoken and written.


As a person, you are self-motivated, proactive and communicative. You take ownership and enjoy driving things forward, while contributing your own ideas on how technical solutions and processes can be improved. You work in a structured and quality-focused way and enjoy collaborating with people with different areas of expertise.
Application
In this recruitment process, Autocom is collaborating with Skill. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. If you have any questions about the role or the recruitment process, please contact Johan Zizala at Skill, johan.zizala@skill.se / 0721-43 93 42.

job_description:
10% of Europe’s CO₂ emissions are caused by residential heating and energy bills are out of control. Aira is here to change that.
With our intelligent Aira Heat Pump at the heart, we’re making the switch to clean energy-tech easier and more affordable. Helping Europe turn off gas and slashing energy costs one home at a time.
Founded in 2022, and with 800+ employees and counting, Aira is driving the clean energy revolution by providing homes with modern clean energy-tech solutions such as solar power, battery storage solutions and heat pumps. With a state-of-the-art production facility in Poland, and HQ in Stockholm, Sweden, and hubs across the UK, Germany and Italy, Aira is well on track to install clean energy-tech into 5 million homes by 2034.
About the role: 
You'll join Aira's central data team, working across the entire customer journey, from acquisition and sales to technical design, installation and live heat pump data. Our work has a direct impact on the tools and processes used across Aira.
We're moving from traditional BI towards self-service analytics, where teams can explore data and answer questions themselves. This will allow us to spend less time on ad hoc reporting and more time solving complex problems using statistics, optimisation and machine learning.
The work is varied. One day you might build data models and metrics for self-service analytics, the next you might use machine learning, statistical modelling or thermodynamics to improve how we design and sell our products.
We’re looking for someone who enjoys both sides of that spectrum: strong analytics engineering and quantitative problem solving, combined with a keen business mindset. 
What you’ll be doing:

Build and maintain data models and metrics using SQL and dbt.


Work with Product teams to define KPIs, track performance and identify areas for improvement.


Develop the semantic layer that powers self-service analytics across Aira.


Use statistics, experimentation, optimisation and machine learning to improve our products and processes.


Use AI-assisted tools such as Claude in your day-to-day work. 


What you’ll bring to the role:

3+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data science, machine learning or a similar quantitative role.


Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets.


Experience with data transformation and dimensional data modelling.


Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to tackle problems that don't have an obvious solution.


An interest in understanding the business and working closely with Product teams to improve how things work. 


Bonus:

A strong quantitative background in mathematics, physics, engineering, statistics or a related field.


Experience developing or deploying machine learning models.


Experience with statistical modelling, experimentation or causal analysis.


Experience working with optimisation problems, physical models or time-series/telemetry data.


Familiarity with cloud data platforms such as GCP, AWS or Azure. 


What you can expect:

Work close to the decisions that shape Aira's customer journey, where your insights can translate directly into changes to our products and processes.


Help move Aira from traditional BI towards self-service analytics, creating more room for advanced modelling and ML.


Work on a broad range of problems spanning analytics engineering, statistics, data science, machine learning and real-world physical systems.


Collaborate closely with Product teams and diverse teams across our international markets.


Gain hands-on experience in a fast-growing scale-up, with a supportive and inclusive culture, and career advancement opportunities.


Develop and grow personally and professionally in an entrepreneurial-minded environment.


Thrive in a dynamic, solution-oriented culture, tackling challenges and driving meaningful solutions that make a positive impact on the world. 


What is in it for you?

Gain hands-on experience in a fast-growing scale-up, with a supportive and inclusive culture, and career advancement opportunities.


Collaborate with diverse teams across international markets and launch products globally.


Develop and grow personally and professionally in an entrepreneurial-minded environment.


Thrive in a dynamic, solution-oriented culture, tackling challenges and driving meaningful solutions that make a positive impact on the world.


Influence the company's success, with a visible impact on product development and market growth.


Enjoy our brand-new office at Norra Stationsgatan 93 in Stockholm. Conveniently located near public transport, with Sankt Eriksplan and Odenplan stations just a few minutes walk away.


At Aira, we champion next-generation energy as well as diversity and inclusion. We firmly believe that a diverse workforce fosters innovation and creativity, enhancing our ability to serve customers and communities effectively. We welcome individuals from all backgrounds, cultures and perspectives to join our team. Our commitment is to uphold equality and inclusivity, fostering a collaborative environment where everyone can thrive and contribute to a better future for our people and the planet.

Guidance Forward AB is looking for an AI Engineer / Data Scientist to work in the Gothenburg area, Sweden.


Work arrangement


Hybrid – our office is at Furumossen 43347 Partille. Depending on project requirements, work may take place at our office or at project locations anywhere in the Gothenburg area, with remote work opportunities.


Employment


Full-time, permanent employment (100%), subject to a genuine employment offer and agreed contract.


Main responsibilities


• Design, develop and implement AI and machine learning solutions.


• Build applications using Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).


• Develop predictive models and data analytics solutions.

Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
 Job Overview
Role Summary
Our client is seeking a Senior Data Platform Engineer for a technically focused consulting assignment with a growing Swedish technology company in Stockholm. The assignment supports an initiative spanning the company’s data and systems landscape. The initial objective is to conduct a structured inventory and assessment of an existing data tool used across several parts of the organization. This work will establish a clear view of current solutions, data assets, integrations, use cases, and dependencies while identifying opportunities for improvement and further development.
The consultant will work closely with the Data Platform team and with technical and business stakeholders. This is a hands-on role suited to an experienced engineer with a strong background in data engineering, data platforms, and cloud infrastructure.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct a structured inventory and mapping of existing data and system solutions.
Document the current data tool, associated data assets, integrations, use cases, and technical dependencies.
Analyze data flows and integrations across the organization’s data and systems landscape.
Collaborate with the Data Platform team and relevant technical and business stakeholders.
Identify improvement opportunities, architectural concerns, and areas of technical debt.
Provide a clear technical foundation for the continued improvement and development of the data environment.

Technical Stack & Requirements
Data Engineering: Strong practical experience analyzing and working with data flows and data-centric solutions.
Data Platforms: Substantial experience with platform environments, shared data capabilities, and organizational data ecosystems.
Cloud Infrastructure: Hands-on experience working with cloud-based infrastructure supporting data solutions.
Systems Integration: Ability to analyze integrations, dependencies, interfaces, and usage patterns across multiple systems.

Qualifications & Experience
The assignment requires a senior-level consultant with extensive experience in data engineering, data platforms, and cloud infrastructure. The successful candidate should be capable of independently assessing an established technical environment, creating structured documentation, and translating findings into actionable improvement opportunities. Experience collaborating with both engineering teams and business-facing stakeholders is important for the assignment.

Dataplattform & Pipelines: Designa och utveckla datapipelines, datamodeller och plattformskapabiliteter i Microsoft Fabric och dbt.

System- & Modellintegration: Integrera språkmodeller med verksamhetsdata, API:er och verktyg i Azure och Microsoft Foundry.  
Kvalitetssäkring & Evals: Etablera tester och utvärderingar (evals, observability, guardrails) som mäter kvalitet, tillförlitlighet och kostnad i våra lösningar.  
Verksamhetsnära utveckling: Arbeta nära verksamheten för att identifiera use-cases, bygga prototyper och omsätta dem till skalbara lösningar.  
Tekniskt ledarskap: Bidra till teknisk riktning, kodgranskning, CI/CD, dokumentation och gemensamma engineering-principer.

Vi söker dig som har
Flera års erfarenhet inom Data Engineering, samt att du under senare tid arbetat med eller skiftat fokus mot AI Engineering.
Mycket goda kunskaper i Python och SQL med erfarenhet av att skriva testbar, produktionsredo kod.
Erfarenhet av Azure (eller liknande molnmiljöer), moderna dataplattformar, ETL/ELT-flöden samt datamodellering.
Praktisk förståelse för generativ AI och språkmodeller (exempelvis RAG, embeddings, vektorsökning eller AI-agenter).
Erfarenhet av API-integrationer, Git, CI/CD och automatisering.
Förmåga att bedöma tekniska lösningar utifrån skalbarhet, säkerhet och mätbar verksamhetsnytta.

Erfarenhet av Microsoft Fabric, Microsoft Foundry eller Azure AI-tjänster.
Hands-on erfarenhet av dbt för strukturerad datamodellering.

Erfarenhet av vektordatabaser och arbete med ostrukturerad data.
Erfarenhet av MLOps/LLMOps, data governance och Power BI.

job_description:
If you're passionate about data, code, and AI, take pride in getting the numbers right, and want to build the data and AI platform behind a fast-growing beauty brand, we'd love to hear from you. Send us your application today!
About the role
Our client is a Stockholm-based global beauty brand. They develop premium, high-performing products at accessible price points, defined by quality and a Scandinavian aesthetic. Driven by an entrepreneurial and creative culture, they combine modern brand storytelling with operational excellence.
Every decision across their organisation, from which shades to restock to which campaigns to scale or markets to expand into, starts with data. Their modern data platform unifies e-commerce, advertising, and retail metrics, while custom AI assistants empower teams to interact with that data directly.
As a Data & AI Engineer, you will join their Tech team and report directly to the CTO. You will collaborate closely with marketing, finance, and operations to build and run the pipelines, services, and AI tooling powering company-wide analytics. From modelling sales data in Dataform to deploying an MCP server that lets AI assistants query BigQuery, you will ensure stakeholders have access to reliable, documented, and timely figures.
This is a great opportunity for someone early in their career or with a couple of years of experience who writes solid SQL, values clean and well-tested code, builds with AI daily, and wants ownership of production systems at a rapidly scaling brand.
Work tasks
You will build and maintain data pipelines, models, and AI-driven services to support business reporting, analytics, and data-informed decisions across the company:
Build and maintain data models in Dataform and BigQuery (incremental models, assertions, and cost-aware partitioning/clustering).  
Ingest data from source systems (e-commerce, advertising platforms, ERP, and retail partners) into BigQuery with scheduling, alerting, and backfills.  
Write and deploy Python or TypeScript services on Google Cloud (Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, Cloud Scheduler) with proper IAM, secrets management, and logging.  
Collaborate with marketing, finance, and operations to translate ambiguous business questions into precise data models and queries.  
Build, deploy, and maintain MCP servers on Cloud Run to connect AI assistants to internal data, applying least-privilege IAM and monitoring.  
Maintain the semantic layer for AI assistants (defining metrics once, writing metadata and catalog documentation, and solving data discrepancies at the source).  
Use coding agents (e.g. Claude Code) as your default development workflow-writing clear task specs, critically reviewing outputs, and shipping tested code via CI/CD.  
Support internal teams in expanding their AI workflows and setting up custom assistants.

We are looking for
A university degree (BSc or MSc) in computer science, software engineering, data engineering, information systems or equivalent.
Up to around two years of experience in data (strong plus) or software engineering – internships, thesis work and serious side projects count.
Solid SQL – joins, window functions, data grain and incremental models.
Hands-on coding in Python or TypeScript; you can write, test and debug a small service on your own.
Exposure to a cloud platform, ideally Google Cloud.
An AI-native way of working – you use coding agents daily and know when not to trust their output.
A collaborative mindset and the ability to explain what you built, and why, to non-technical colleagues.
Curiosity, a quick learning curve and comfort in a fast-paced environment.
Fluent Swedish and English.

It is meritorious if you have
Production experience with BigQuery, and with Dataform or dbt.
Experience with dimensional modelling and data quality testing.
An understanding of containers, service accounts, least-privilege access and basic networking.
Experience in e-commerce, retail or consumer brands.
Experience building or integrating LLM-based tooling – MCP, function calling or agents. Side projects count.

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
Stress tolerant
Goal oriented
Orderly
Responsible
Intellectually curious

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

Role Summary
An experienced AI Software Engineer is needed to join a data platform team focused on semantic modelling, large language models (LLMs), and unstructured data. In this hands-on engineering assignment, you will help extend a governed semantic layer spanning both structured warehouse data and document-based information. The role focuses on building reliable AI-powered data capabilities with traceability, permission-aware retrieval, and production-quality implementation.

Strong development skills in Python and/or TypeScript.
Practical experience with LLM-based solutions, including agents and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
Experience with unstructured-data processing, including document parsing, information extraction, entity resolution, embeddings, and retrieval.
Strong SQL skills and understanding of relational data models and data warehouses.
Experience with semantic modelling or semantic layers, such as dbt Semantic Layer or Malloy, is advantageous.
Knowledge of ontologies or knowledge graphs is advantageous.
Experience with Google Cloud Platform, Snowflake, or data governance practices is advantageous.

Qualifications & Experience
The ideal candidate has at least 5 years of experience building and operating production systems with a strong focus on code quality and testing. A degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience is required. Experience working with semantic data models, knowledge graphs, cloud data platforms, and governed data environments is considered beneficial.

With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
Job Overview
Role Summary
Our client is seeking a senior Data Scientist / ML Engineer for a consulting assignment focused on data-driven pricing. The organization has recently developed a machine learning-based pricing model that generates price recommendations during the quotation process. The solution is currently at an early stage, and the next objective is to take ownership of the model, understand its behavior, and establish a sustainable approach to its long-term management and continued development.
The consultant will play a central role in reviewing the existing solution, evaluating how the model is structured and operates, and enabling the organization to independently understand, use, maintain, and enhance it. The assignment combines hands-on model work with technical advisory responsibilities and internal knowledge transfer.
Key Responsibilities
Gain a thorough understanding of the existing machine learning-based pricing model and its role in generating quotation price recommendations.
Review and assess the model's architecture, statistical foundations, behavior, and current implementation.
Evaluate the model's operational readiness and identify improvements needed for sustainable long-term ownership and maintenance.
Support the organization in taking over responsibility for the model and establishing appropriate management and development practices.
Work hands-on with the predictive model to understand, validate, and improve its functionality.
Explain technical, statistical, and model-related concepts to business stakeholders and other relevant audiences.
Provide expert guidance on how the model can be used and further developed.
Contribute to building internal competence in data science, machine learning, and predictive modeling.

Technical Stack & Requirements
Machine Learning: Strong experience developing and working with machine learning solutions.
Predictive Modeling: Experience with predictive models that have been deployed into production environments.
Model Evaluation: Ability to review model construction, statistical logic, behavior, and practical performance.
Model Lifecycle Management: Experience establishing maintainable processes for model ownership, operation, and continued development.
Statistical Analysis: Ability to interpret and communicate statistical relationships to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Qualifications & Experience
The assignment requires a senior Data Scientist or ML Engineer with practical experience in machine learning and production-deployed predictive models. The successful consultant should be capable of independently analyzing an existing solution, combining technical implementation work with strategic advice, and transferring knowledge to internal teams. Experience communicating complex technical and statistical concepts to varied stakeholder groups is important.

job_description:
Careium is looking for a Data Engineer to help us shape and build a modern data and delivery platform from the ground up. If you have a strong drive to do things properly and take ownership of your work, then this is the job for you.
About Careium
Careium delivers solutions within personal safety and connected care. We have a global presence but work with a strong local feel, and right now we are in a phase where there is real work to be done - automation, data infrastructure, and smarter ways of building and shipping software are all on the table.
About the Role
As a Data Engineer in the platform team, you will be the driving force behind our data infrastructure. You will work closely with both software developers and the wider organization to ensure that our data is accessible, reliable, and structured for the future.
Day to day you will be working with things like:

Implementing and expanding our central data lake and data warehouse, building upon the completed initial design and its main components.


Setting up and maintaining robust ETL/ELT pipelines to ingest data from various internal and external sources.


Continuing the groundwork of our event-driven platform enabling real-time alarm data and user activity.


Moving existing data integrations and legacy data streams onto the new modern platform.


Getting data documentation, a data catalogue, and data governance frameworks in place.


Collaborating with DevOps colleagues in the team to automate data infrastructure deployments and monitoring.


Coaching developers and analysts in data engineering best practices and efficient querying.


Who We Are Looking For
You should have solid hands-on experience from a Data Engineering role and a genuine interest in cloud architecture, data modeling, and streaming data. Since you will be part of a platform team, a DevOps mindset regarding automation, containerization, and infrastructure as code is a big plus.
It helps if you have worked with tools like:

Python, Bash, Ansible, Terraform, or equivalent.


AWS, or other cloud providers.


Docker, Kubernetes, or equivalent.


Streaming and event-hub technologies like Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, or AWS Kinesis.


Data transformation and orchestration tools (dbt, Apache Airflow, or similar) as well as modern data warehousing.


Just as important as the technical side, you communicate well, you are easy to work with, and you bring a calm, structured approach when things get complicated. You follow through on what you commit to, and you are not afraid to flag when something is not working.
Practical Information
Location: Malmö Scope: Full-time Work model: Hybrid, as agreed Employment type: 6-month assignment through A-hub. The recruitment process is managed by A-hub. Questions about the role are answered by the recruiter responsible.
